method_limitation.statement: No general web search engine was reachable from this environment on 2026-08-22. DuckDuckGo lite and html both returned HTTP 202 with a bot challenge asking to select squares containing a duck, Brave returned HTTP 429, Mojeek returned HTTP 403, and searx.be returned a browser-verification interstitial. Negative existence is therefore established only across GitHub, the Chrome Web Store, npm, PyPI and DNS. A product with no presence on any of those surfaces would not have been found.

resolutions.recommended_disambiguation: Ask the founder one question with concrete options rather than researching further: was the intended product (a) a browser sidebar assistant in the same family as HARPA and Sider, (b) a cloud browser service that holds logins, in the family of Airtop and Browserbase, (c) a voice or dictation tool, or (d) something else entirely. Any of those answers costs one sentence and resolves in minutes what unbounded search cannot.

resolutions.conclusion: Goose has moved out of the Block organisation into aaif-goose, described on GitHub as the goose ai agent platform, and the project README states it is part of the Agentic AI Foundation at the Linux Foundation. The prior halted batch cited aaif-goose/goose, which is correct.

resolutions.resolved_to: HARPA AI (harpa.ai), a proprietary Chrome extension, plus HARPA GRID, its cloud browser-orchestration API
resolutions.conclusion: Two distinct things share one name and they have very different trust boundaries. The extension is local and its store listing declares no data collection. GRID is a cloud API whose own documentation states that it orchestrates your machine to run the tasks for you, handling data behind logins. Treating them as one candidate would hide the decision that actually matters.

evidence.result: product site retrieved; describes a hybrid browser-automation and AI engine supporting bring-your-own model including local Llama
redirects to /grid/web-automation; Browser Orchestration API documentation retrieved
300,000 users, 4.7 from 3.2K ratings, EU trader identified, developer discloses no data collection

resolutions.resolved_to: Moonshot AI's Kimi family, currently flagship kimi-k3
resolutions.conclusion: The GitHub repository MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2 that the name most obviously points at was last pushed 2026-01-21 and documents a superseded generation. The live surfaces are the Kimi API platform, which documents kimi-k3 as flagship, and the model weights on Hugging Face. Citing the repository as the product would have described a January artifact as the current route.

evidence.result: kimi-k3 documented as flagship; kimi-k2.6 also current
